method: Saved native 0.5um-inscribed filled copper polygons; plated GND pad/via continuity across both layers. No refill or CAD mutation. Centerline support and full strip support are separate metrics. Coplanar sampled straight-section rays at 0.025 mm.
limitations: Geometry only, not measured or fabricated impedance, EMC qualification or USB compliance.
Saved filled zones must be freshly refilled by final native validation before this audit.
Coupled 0.4 mm main pair excludes connector PTH duplicate-pin crosslinks and ESD branches; CPU launch is separately quantified.
Nominal dielectric assumption requires confirmation of factory finished stackup: core 1.51 mm, copper 0.035 mm, mask 0.01 mm, FR4 er 4.2.
ground_reference_anchor: U1 ground pads; a port-only island is not treated as grounded
